entity.name: axi_stream_packet_router_top
entity.description: Design an AXI-Stream packet router or small network-switch style fabric in VHDL with scalable routing, deterministic arbitration, and verifiable valid/ready handshake behavior.

behavior: Design an AXI-Stream packet router or small network-switch style fabric in VHDL with scalable routing, deterministic arbitration, and verifiable valid/ready handshake behavior.
Required block/responsibility: AXI-Stream source/sink interface handling
Required block/responsibility: arbitration logic for contended outputs
Required block/responsibility: packet or frame tracking support as needed by the architecture
Required block/responsibility: top-level scalable switch/router integration
Backpressure behavior must be deterministic and represented in the RTL.
Scalability should come from clean structure or generics, not copied ad hoc logic.
Use a single deterministic streaming clock domain unless an alternative is explicitly justified.
Reset must place all handshake/control state into a known idle condition.
Handshake behavior must never depend on gated clocks or hidden latches.
corner_cases: Cover handshake correctness, contention, routing correctness, and backpressure scenarios.
Include representative packet-flow cases and deterministic pass/fail checks.
prohibited_implementations: Do not claim AXI-Stream compatibility while omitting valid/ready semantics.
Do not ignore backpressure or contention handling.
Do not flatten a scalable switch into undocumented one-off wiring.
synthesis_requirements: Generated RTL and verification files must compile, elaborate, and simulate under GHDL.
The testbench must demonstrate correct valid/ready behavior under both nominal and contended cases.
The architecture must show a credible routing and arbitration structure.
testbench_obligations: Cover handshake correctness, contention, routing correctness, and backpressure scenarios.
Include representative packet-flow cases and deterministic pass/fail checks.
